text:
ana: New model v2.1 landed in staging. Want to propose a multimetric canary that combines MRR delta, hallucination rate (eval suite), and p95 latency. Thoughts on hysteresis + auto-fallback thresholds?

mike: +1. We shouldn't trigger on single metric spikes. Suggest composite score: weighted sum of normalized deltas. Example weights: 0.5 MRR, 0.3 hallucination, 0.2 latency.

sophie: Also add min sample size (N>=500) and a cooldown window (10m) before flip. For latency, use p95 and tail count > X.

eva: Agree. What about absolute vs relative thresholds? For MRR use relative drop > 2% and hallucination absolute increase > 0.5%.

tony: If composite score crosses 0.7 for 3 consecutive windows (5m each) -> auto-fallback. If 0.5-0.7 -> alert and slow rollout pause. :eyes:

ana: Nice. Quick config sketch:

```yaml
canary:
  windows: 5m
  min_samples: 500
  metrics:
    mrr: {weight: 0.5, delta_type: relative, threshold: 0.02}
    hallucination: {weight: 0.3, delta_type: absolute, threshold: 0.005}
    latency_p95: {weight: 0.2, delta_type: relative, threshold: 0.10}
  composite_cutoffs:
    alert: 0.5
    pause: 0.6
    autofallback: 0.7
  hysteresis: {windows_required: 3}
```

mike: Looks good. We should also penalize noisy slices: add variance multiplier to lower weight when seqlen variance > X.

sophie: Will run a quick shadow compare on yesterday's traffic to see how many false positives this would have.

rollout-bot: Shadow run started for v2.1 against v2.0 on sample slice 'longdocs' (10k requests). ETA ~12m.

eva: FYI, in prior int4 canary we saw latency p95 jitter on cold KV misses. Add kv_warmup flag to exempt first N requests per session.

ana: Good call. Let's reconvene after the shadow run. If false-positive rate < 1% we'll try a 1% traffic canary with these rules. /cc @mike @sophie @eva :thumbsup:

mike: ack

sophie: on it

rollout-bot: Shadow run finished. Composite alert rate: 0.6% (66/10000). False positives manually inspected: 8. Recommended action: proceed to 1% canary with kv_warmup=3 and 15m cooldown.

eva: LGTM. I'll schedule the canary for 10:30 PT and add the rollout config to the PR.

ana: Thanks team. I'll open the PR with the YAML and rollout plan.
